limitations: Empirical nearest-rank tune quantiles, not population tails or SLA. Same OD clusters across windows/blocks; no independence or convergence claim.
All offered counts retained; attempted and transit latency conditioning explicit; not-run/unresolved no latency.
Fresh processes with no discarded warmup pass; load,router/checker/quality preparation separate; OS pages read by prelaunch hashes; not disk cold.
Cloud CPU affinity, not exclusive cores; soft memory limit and sampled RSS safeguards, not hard confinement.
Native2D and3D output contracts differ; no cross-contract equal-quality speedup or global optimality claim.
